observed_facts: Verifies SHA256/signature before atomic staging; rollback and bounded tar extraction implemented.
Dispatches supervision kinds, preserves last-good sidecar specs and uses privileged updater for capabilities/systemd lifecycle.
Actual goplugin.NewClient AutoMTLS/GRPC/UDS, per-runner restart backoff and circuit breaker; manager tests present.
Staged-approved-denied-revoked state machine and provenance/artifact fields exist.
Validates approved package and config schema on create/update.
Artifacts missing baseline are reported then skipped, so no size regression fails for them.
Pinned baseline contents are empty JSON object.
Removes bundled optional RDP runtime and legacy sidecar manager; adds platform/version/artifact delivery gates.

limitations: No project tests were independently run.
ServiceRadar source SHAs have differed from available GitHub history; evidence uses explicitly named recovered public commits, not an assumption that original links still resolve.
Date is a reviewed code-integration evidence event, not independently established earliest completion.
review_depth: Read complete specification and related task packet; inspected implementation/test evidence described in sources.
